media.yml.rawContents:
imports:
  root: __package__.yml
types:
  CreateMediaRequestInputsItem:
    discriminant:
      value: type
      context: data
    base-properties: {}
    union:
      video: root.VideoInput
      watermark: root.WatermarkInput
      audio: root.AudioInput
      subtitle: root.SubtitleInput
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  CreateMediaResponse:
    properties:
      id: optional<string>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    createMedia:
      path: /media
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: CreateMediaRequest
        body:
          properties:
            inputs:
              docs: Add one input at a time.
              type: list<CreateMediaRequestInputsItem>
        content-type: application/json
      response:
        docs: Success
        type: CreateMediaResponse
        status-code: 200
      examples:
        - request:
            inputs:
              - url: https://example.com/video.mp4
                type: video
          response:
            body:
              id: id
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
